video.title: PreviewProvider, Previewable & PreviewModifier | Day 185
video.description:
Learn to explain how SwiftUI previews work, from the old way to the new way: PreviewProvider, Previewable & PreviewModifier, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
PreviewProvider - The older protocol for writing previews, with a static previews property.
Previewable - A macro that lets you write state directly inside a preview.
PreviewModifier - A protocol for shared setup that many previews can use.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: SwiftUI PreviewProvider, Previewable & PreviewModifier | Day 185
landscape.description:
Explain PreviewProvider, Previewable & PreviewModifier in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
프리뷰프로바이더, 프리뷰어블, 프리뷰모디파이어 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

PreviewProvider - The older protocol for writing previews, with a static previews property.
한국어: 프리뷰프로바이더: static previews 프로퍼티로 프리뷰를 만드는 예전 프로토콜

Previewable - A macro that lets you write state directly inside a preview.
한국어: 프리뷰어블: 프리뷰 안에 상태를 바로 쓸 수 있게 해 주는 매크로

PreviewModifier - A protocol for shared setup that many previews can use.
한국어: 프리뷰모디파이어: 여러 프리뷰가 함께 쓸 수 있는 공통 설정을 위한 프로토콜

In this video, Mina and Jake move an old project to the new preview style, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Can you explain PreviewProvider, Previewable and PreviewModifier in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my old project has a different preview style.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a PreviewProvider. It was the old way to make previews.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new project uses a hash symbol. What is that?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is the `#Preview` macro, and it is shorter. But the PreviewProvider still works.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: In my `#Preview`, I need a state for a toggle.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add Previewable before the state. Then you can write `@State` right inside the preview.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Before that, I made a small wrapper view just for the preview.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You do not need it now. Previewable removes the wrapper.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I also want every preview in dark mode, with shared sample data.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Make a PreviewModifier. It builds the shared setup once for your previews.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can many previews use the same PreviewModifier?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, you pass it to each preview, and it saves time.
Old projects still use a PreviewProvider.
